message.content:
This editorial illustration is the front cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large red capital letters. The background is solid black. Below the title is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the top, white text reads "Diplomasi Prabowo tanpa Arah H.28" and "Jalan Pintas Mengatur Pinjaman Online H.132". A barcode, QR code, date range "30 DESEMBER 2024 - 5 JANUARI 2025", and price "RP 60.000" are in the upper right.

The central image features seventeen stylized portraits of people’s heads and shoulders, arranged in a triangular cluster against the black background. These faces are rendered in a high-contrast, monochromatic style with yellow skin tones and black shadows. Most individuals have small, reddish-orange horizontal marks on their lips. The figures vary in age, gender, and expression, looking in various directions. One person in the foreground wears glasses and has white hair.

At the bottom right, yellow and white text reads "EDISI KHUSUS TOKOH 2024", "MEREKA YANG TAK LELAH MELAWAN", and several lines of smaller white text ending in "H.36". A red, L-shaped graphic is positioned above this text.
